tail:
Batch 23 authoring is complete. I added the three A-page items and the neutral-field counterexample on B, plus both page files, the manifest, proof contracts, source coverage, cross-batch dependencies, notes, and four current Step 1 `ready` records.

The Definition retains the Coulomb phase, gauge and unit conventions, and the conditional nature of the scattering data. The radial equation and Wronskian identity have complete local proofs. Full-text sources were retrieved and inspected: [Brito, Cardoso, and Pani](https://arxiv.org/pdf/1501.06570) and [Balakumar’s thesis](https://inspirehep.net/files/c9d9d32ca091d580007a1fee1bb44dc0).

Scoped checks passed: content policy, proof contracts, dependency closure, rendering, precheck, proof layout, coverage, and source fetch. The assigned item levels are 2, 3, 4, and 5. Details are in the [batch notes](/home/lazyinspirit/Projects/prestige-math-library/physics/research/physics-non-fluid-129-2026-10-21-r2-batch-23.notes.md), [A page](/home/lazyinspirit/Projects/prestige-math-library/physics/library/einstein-maxwell-models-mathematics/emg-fx08.md), and [B page](/home/lazyinspirit/Projects/prestige-math-library/physics/library/einstein-maxwell-models-mathematics/emg-fx08-examples.md).

Two run-wide checks remain blocked outside this batch: item-level checking reports 37 unrelated empty inventories, and batch-level checking reports a stale shared schedule hash. Its stored batch-23 row still matches the recomputed level 3 with supplier batch 21. I recorded both findings and left the shared schedule for the owner.
